description: Silence alerts (or pause checks) for a deploy or planned work, starting now unless a start time is given. Covers every monitor unless monitor_ids is given.

monitor_ids.description: Only these monitors. Leave out for all.

organization.description: Organization id. Leave out to use your own account; resellers can name a client organization.

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 start time. Defaults to now.

suppress.description: alerts (default) keeps checking but alerts nobody; checks stops checking altogether.

title.description: What the work is, e.g. "Deploy v2.4".

name: start_maintenance
title: Start a maintenance window
